appDescription: An in-car errand agent that handles running late for reservations and ordering pickups along the route based on the navigation arrival time, and can undo an errand it just completed.

function.name: NOTIFY_LATE_ARRIVAL
function.description: Handle the situation where the driver is running late for an appointment or reservation by estimating the delay from the navigation arrival time and rescheduling it to a new time the user approves.

appointmentTime.description: Originally scheduled time of the appointment or reservation in 24-hour HH:mm format.

confirmedTime.description: New reservation time the user explicitly approved after being asked, in 24-hour HH:mm format.

function.name: ORDER_PICKUP_ON_ROUTE
function.description: Order food or drinks for pickup at a store along the current navigation route, timed to the driver's arrival.

item.description: Name of the food or drink the user wants to pick up.

storeName.description: Name or brand of the store the user wants to order from.

confirmed.description: Whether the user explicitly approved the proposed store and pickup time after being asked.

function.name: CANCEL_LAST_ERRAND
function.description: Undo the errand PitCrew completed in the last few minutes, such as restoring a changed reservation, cancelling a pickup order, or cancelling a restaurant waitlist, when the user says it was a mistake or wants to cancel it.

confirmed.description: Whether the user explicitly approved undoing the errand after being told what will be undone.
